verdict.rationale: Agent identity is a fair question for an identity platform like Entra ID, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents AI agents as first-class identities, cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials. The only nearby item is generic application management (permissions, tokens, certificates for apps), which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, AI agents are first-class identities — documented patterns for securing agent access to apps (cross-app access, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials)
